text:
sam_csm: Heads up — HelixOps renewal is next Tue. They emailed wanting either a 6-month extension (no price change) OR a prorated credit and immediate re-sign. Also asking for an SLA uplift to 99.9% and to roll over unused onboarding training hours into the next term.

maria_cs: TL;DR on the options? customer success POV: extension reduces churn risk but delays revenue recognition. prorate gives cash now.

nate_sales: Their CFO prefers cash (prorate) but the VP of Eng pushed SLA uplift and more training. they said budget freeze might be lifted if we include 8 extra training hours.

sam_csm: Proposed offer: 6mo extension + 15% one-time credit on monthly invoices OR prorated refund for remaining months + no training rollover. plus conditional SLA uplift (99.9) if they commit to dedicated capacity (Dedicated plan).

jacob_fin: Finance needs clear PO path. If they take extension with credit we can invoice as amendment (net30). If they want prorate refund we need refund approval code and vendor code for routing. PO by Friday to hit next-week cutover.

lisa_secure: Security asks for a quick check — they requested an updated DPA clause (data residency wording) and a minor SC-1 addendum. Legal will need to sign off before the SLA change.

maria_cs: Risk: if legal blocks SLA change, customer might insist on prorate + go to competitor. we should have fallback.

sam_csm: Can we offer a temporary 30-day pilot extension with training block while legal reviews SLA? that buys time and keeps them engaged. also we could auto-apply 4 training hours immediately, hold 4 pending signed amendment.
nate_sales: Sales is ok with split training. But pricing manager flagged that discount cliffs after renewal will hurt quota. Need to confirm comp implications.
jacob_fin: Action: finance to confirm vendor code and refund process by Thu EOD. If refund path is required, escalate to billing ops.
lisa_secure: Action: I'll route the SC-1 draft to Legal team. ETA 48 hrs.
sam_csm: I'll prep the amendment docsend and propose the exact wording for training rollover and SLA conditions. link: https://docsend.example.com/helixops-renewal-draft (internal)
deploybot: Reminder — contract amendment template v3 was used for last 3 renewals. attach: contract/amendments/v3 (auto-note) :robot_face:
maria_cs: For enablement scheduling: proposed kickoff Wed 10am PST. If they take the pilot extension we can run 2 sessions that week.
nate_sales: I'll confirm with their VP of Eng and drop PO timeline.
sam_csm: OK. Summary + owners: Finance (jacob_fin) -> confirm vendor code/refund path by Thu. Legal (lisa_secure) -> DPA/SC-1 review in 48h. Sales (nate_sales) -> confirm decision & PO timeline w/ customer. CS (maria_cs & sam_csm) -> prep amendment + enablement schedule.
maria_cs: leaving a note: if they prefer prorate we should offer a quick SOW for training purchasable as separate line item (prevents rollover).
sam_csm: Thanks. I'll update the CRM with both offers and tag the renewal as HIGH RISK until we get PO or signed amendment.
maria_cs: :thumbsup:
